Interested in Redwood for: streaming + model pinning + managed embeddings + private deploy option for regulated EU clients. use_case_summary: Primary: IDE copilot integrated in VS Code for code completion + contextual search. Secondary: repo-wide semantic search/reranking for code review, automated PR summaries, and reranking-based intent routing. Must support per-commit/PR context and incremental embedding updates. High concurrency during working hours (~200 concurrent editors), target tail-latency 95th <120ms for single token streaming in editor session.
technical_requirements: Repository size: ~3.2M LOC, mono-repo with submodules — need per-repo and per-PR indexes
Embeddings: prefer instruction-tuned code+semantic model; tolerance for 1-2% quality delta vs reference
Vector DB: customer neutral; POC prefers Redwood-managed vector index with easy export/import; need snapshot & incremental delta sync APIs
Chunking: adaptive chunker (semantic boundaries, function/class-aware), prefer 256-1024 token window depending on language; avoid noisy fragments
Residency: EU data residency required for 30% of customers, logs and vectors must be stored in EU region and subject to KMS controls
Latency: streaming target 50-80ms/token median, 95th <120ms when using Dedicated or Private
Model/version pinning: per-customer pinned model with transparent fallbacks (quantized variant) and ability to pin generation params and tokenizer version
Caching: prefix/KV cache desirable across editor sessions; invalidation on repo push/PR merge
Cost controls: recommendations for batching and quantized variants for background tasks (summaries) vs interactive completion
Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence, audit logs for inference and vector ops, KMS integration for vector encryption
poc_plan: Week 0: legal/security review + residency addendum (target sign 2026-03-15)
Week 1-2: Indexing POC — ingest 1 repo snapshot, validate chunking heuristics, compare embed quality (baseline)
Week 3: Editor streaming integration — VS Code extension hook, live generation streaming test with pinned model
Week 4: Delta sync test — simulate PRs and ensure incremental embedding update without full reindex
Week 5: Performance run — 200 concurrent editors, measure 50/95/99 latencies, iterate on batching/cache policies
Week 6: Handover & SLA proposal; deliverable: architecture doc + cost estimate + playbook for rollouts
